ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between dominant low-intensity (black) integument (~90% surface area) and high-intensity (white) barnacle clusters and scars (~10% surface area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black regions across the central fluke. High-intensity white clusters localized at the distal tips. Randomly oriented linear high-intensity streaks distributed across the mid-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior pixel angle of 110 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 5% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with pixel-amplitudes of peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels; highest irregularity observed on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a steep vertical sweep at the outer fluke margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacles) on the lateral tips; secondary cluster of white circular scars visible on the lower right fluke margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel, high-contrast white linear tracks (rake marks) intersecting across the primary dark pigmentation field of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle accumulation on both fluke tips and distinct linear rake mark scarring across the ventral surface.
